_note: HARD RULE for the daily LinkedIn post. Read this file on every run and obey it over any other instruction in the job prompt. It is not advisory: an app outside these categories is never posted, no matter how fresh, how popular or how easy to write about.

allow.medical-health: Clinical reference, homeopathic repertories and materia medica, patient and case tracking, OPD and practice tools, medical calculators, drug and anatomy references, study tools for clinical subjects.
allow.mind-mental-health: Mood, calm, sleep, breathing, meditation, journaling, attention, memory, psychology, mind-body.
allow.lifestyle-wellness: Diet and nutrition, fitness, habits, hydration, fasting, yoga and posture, women's health, elder care, personal health tracking.

deny: anything not clearly in one of the three allowed categories
rules: Decide the category from the repo's own README, not from its name.
If the category is ambiguous, skip the repo. Never guess in favour of posting.
If no in-scope app is left for the month, post nothing and say so in one line.
If the in-scope pool comes out far below the usual 20-35, treat it as a discovery failure, fix it, and never post from the broken list.
A game is never in scope. The word 'wellness' in a game's description does not make it a wellness app.
Never claim medical, diagnostic or treatment capability, and never present an app as a substitute for a doctor.
